steps.text: Bring a shovel and a rope.
steps.source: Required Equipment: Shovel, Rope or Magic Rope

steps.text: Go down into the Ancient Temple north of Thais, two floors.
Head as far north as you can and go down two floors to the rotworms.
Follow the path east and south and go down the ladder (rotworms, poison spiders, orcs and orc spearmen).
Through the poison fields (antidote or destroy field) and down another level.
Follow the path east and north (poison spiders, minotaurs) and go down the hole (cyclopes).
Up two ladders in the north-west, then down two floors again and follow the long tunnel (minotaurs) to Mintwallin: go down into the city.
In Mintwallin go south and up the stairs to the throne room.
steps.source: When you have come to Mintwallin you go south and up the stairs to the throne room

steps.text: Take the ladder slightly south-west of the stairs.
steps.source: and you take the ladder slightly southwest from the stairs in there.

steps.text: Go down into the pit: a dragon.
steps.source: When you have gone down the ladder in to the pit, you will face 1 dragon

steps.text: Go down the hole: two dragons.
steps.source: and when you go down the hole you will face 2 dragons.

steps.text: North of the room: the small ruby lies under the fire.
steps.source: Browse the field on the fire located north of the room.
